title: Room Identity Sequence
description: A reference-led live-session sequence establishing one recording room, one musician identity, and one intimate performance mood across multiple stills.
creative_direction: The root image defines the exact musician, room palette, and recording-session atmosphere. The following images preserve the same face, hair base, body proportions, room identity, and stripped-back performance realism while shifting angle and performance detail.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-control-room-session first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-piano-corner-take, 03-microphone-stand-take, 04-midnight-drum-room. Queue may run 02-piano-corner-take, 03-microphone-stand-take, 04-midnight-drum-room concurrently after 01-reference-control-room-session is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
